title: Was ou were?
regra: Pra falar do passado do verbo to be: com I / he / she / it (uma pessoa ou coisa) → was. Com you / we / they e com plural (my parents, my friends) → were.

exemplos.en: My parents were at the beach.

fofoca.gaps: Last Saturday, my parents [[were]] at the beach. My brother [[was]] at home, alone. He [[was]] bored, so he called his friends. But his friends [[were]] busy. They [[were]] at a party! So my brother [[was]] alone all day. Poor guy!

options: My friends were at the party.
My friends was at the party.
My friend was at the party.
